description: This Java class is a Spring MVC controller for managing products within an e-commerce platform's admin interface. It includes methods for creating, editing, duplicating, removing images, and managing product-category associations.

classes.name: ProductController
classes.description: Spring MVC controller handling administrative operations for products in the e-commerce platform.

methods.name: displayProductEdit
methods.description: Handles GET request to display the product edit page for a given product ID.

methods.name: displayProductCreate
methods.description: Handles GET request to display the product creation page.

methods.name: displayProduct
methods.description: Private method to prepare model data for creating or editing a product, including loading related entities.

methods.name: saveProduct
methods.description: Handles POST request to save or update a product, including validation and image handling.

methods.name: duplicateProduct
methods.description: Handles POST request to create a duplicate of an existing product, copying its properties but ignoring SKU and images.

methods.name: removeImage
methods.description: Handles POST request to remove a product image identified by its ID.

methods.name: displayAddProductToCategories
methods.description: Handles GET request to display categories for linking a product.

methods.name: pageProductCategories
methods.description: Returns JSON listing categories associated with a product, for pagination or display.

methods.name: deleteProductFromCategory
methods.description: Removes the association between a product and a category.

methods.name: addProductToCategory
methods.description: Associates a product with a category.

methods.name: setMenu
methods.description: Helper method to set up menu-related attributes in the model.
